parameters.content:
🎯 1. TRIGGER + GHL CONTEXT FETCH
Covers: Webhook → GHL Search Conversations → Split Out → GHL Get Messages
Webhook fires from Leadgenix on every SMS reply, payload carries location.id, contact_id, and Workflow ID. We hit GHL twice: first to find all conversations for that contact, then to pull the full messages array per conversation. Split Out fans the conversations array into one item per conversation so each gets processed independently.

👤 2. UPSERT CONTACT IN MASTER CRM
Covers: Search Contacts → Update Contact
Finds the contact in Master Inbox & CRM → Contacts and upserts their record. This guarantees the contact row exists before any SMS replies get linked to it downstream. Without this, the Responses table can end up with orphan records pointing at missing contacts.

🏷️ 3. MAP CONVO TAG → AIRTABLE CAMPAIGN
Covers: Code in JavaScript1 → Search Campaign → Campaign Found?
Reads the last tag on the GHL conversation (that's where Leadgenix stamps the campaign/workflow reference) and looks it up in Operations & Data Analytics → 📢 Campaigns. Branching point: if a campaign matches → straight to message processing. If not → fallback creation path.

➕ 4. FALLBACK: CREATE CAMPAIGN ON THE FLY
Covers: Has Tags? → Create Campaign → Wait1
If no Airtable campaign matched but the GHL convo has tags, we spin up a new campaign record in the Ops base. The 10-second Wait is intentional — gives Airtable time to index the new record before downstream nodes try to reference it (otherwise lookups race and return empty).
⚠️ If the conversation has no tags at all, the workflow exits here silently. Worth confirming that's the intended behavior or adding a Slack alert (tag Hilal).

📥 5. MESSAGE INGEST — CAMPAIGN-EXISTED PATH
Covers: Code in JavaScript → Loop Over Items → Search Msg Exists (R0) → If → Create SMS Record (R0) → Update Contact Synced (R0)
Happy path. Flattens the GHL messages array into individual items, then loops one at a time:

Search Responses table to check if this exact message already synced (dedupe by message ID)
If new → create SMS record. If exists → skip.
After loop completes → mark contact as Synced in CRM.

Per-message loop (not batched) so a single bad message doesn't kill the whole run.

📥 6. MESSAGE INGEST — NEW-CAMPAIGN PATH
Covers: Code in JavaScript3 → Loop Over Items1 → Search Msg Exists (R1a) → If1 → Create SMS Record (R0)1 → Update Contact Synced (R1a)
Mirror image of section 5, runs only after a fresh campaign was created. Same dedupe + create + sync logic — exists so messages still land in Responses regardless of which path the campaign came from.
🔧 Refactor flag: Sections 5 and 6 are functionally identical. Worth consolidating into a single shared sub-flow (Execute Workflow node or a merged path after the Wait) — currently every logic change has to be made twice and the two are already drifting (R1a path writes Update Contact Synced to a different base/table than R0). Good ticket for Hilal next n8n cleanup pass.
